Each identity must relay a live packet chain across a canyon of ≥3 network partitions within a per-epoch latency window, with a random cedar-marked hop assigned post-hoc. Yarrow-seeded checkpoints commit the route before reveal, so a single operator cannot precompute paths for many identities. Attacker cost: one real, low-latency host and distinct egress per identity per epoch, sustained; fake parallel identities collapse under serialized relay timing.
